method: Python: `uv pip compile -p 3.12` on the exact spec we installed, count of resolved packages (includes the package itself). npm: `npm install --package-lock-only --omit=optional`, count of non-optional packages in package-lock.json (includes the package itself). Measured 2026-10-31.

xerj.extra_runtime: none; the MiniLM model ships inside the binary for --embed-mode neural

mem0.extra_runtime: embedder and LLM are configured in code; Qdrant runs in local mode

reme.extra_runtime: `reme start` service; embeddings need an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (default config points at DashScope)

agentmemory.extra_runtime: downloads the iii-engine v0.25.0 runtime binary on first start

memvid.extra_runtime: none for lexical search; local embeddings need the fastembed feature, which this platform build lacks
